conventions.sizes: Relative scope/risk S/M/L/XL, not calendar estimates.
conventions.existing_beads: Reuse/amend/split exact scope per repo report; closed items are references, never instructions to reopen.

conventions.evidence: Research baseline 2026-09-12; priority revision 2026-09-13. Source inspection is not runtime certification; original Beads status remains a dated snapshot.
